final_text:
I submitted run ADD-03-host-20261005T184804Z-0589 with status "partial". I read no crops, since this batch has no image units. Both of my provisions are covered; "partial" refers to the 55 other ADD-03 provisions, which belong to other batches.

- **5.1** (evidence verified): replaces "not more than 5 OU/m³ at the site boundary" in Volume II Clause 3.4 with the reference to Figure 7-2 of the environmental impact assessment. I fixed the reference draft, which wrote "m3" where the documents print "m³".
- **5.1 clarification** (insufficient evidence): Figure 7-2 is not in the pack, so the new odour limit can't be read from it. The question also notes that the addendum's cover page names Clause 3.5, which is the noise clause, instead of 3.4.
- **5.2** (interpretation pending): records the requirement to show compliance with amended Clause 3.4 in the Technical Proposal as a new obligation. A person needs to confirm this reading.
